info.name: Sugarloop API — v1
info.description:
Every endpoint implemented so far.

Run the whole thing with the Collection Runner, top to bottom — requests depend on variables set by earlier ones (branchId, accessToken, productSlug, orderId). Running a single request out of order may fail for that reason alone.

Requires: the API on {{baseUrl}}, MongoDB reachable, and `npm run seed` already run.

BUILT BUT NOT COVERED HERE (the API serves these; this collection simply has no requests for them yet): POST /branches/resolve, /staff/products/*, /staff/reports/*.
